title: jsonl (one line)
description: DATA ROWS: one JSON object per line (a file whose whole text is one JSON array of objects is accepted too). This schema describes ONE LINE: a row, or a DIRECTIVE — a line whose keys all start with `$` — that composes the rows live from other files.
x-studio-file: one JSON object per line; this schema describes a line

then.description: A directive line. Several may be split across lines; `$sources` and `$labels` accumulate, a second scalar replaces the first.

oneOf.description: `file`, or `file#key` for the list a .json object holds under `key`.

$sources.description: Files whose rows are read live: a .json array or object, a .jsonl, a .csv, a .middleware (its chain followed), a .pipeline (`#stage` or `#view`).

$policy.description: The table policy (`role: table`) the rows pass through.

$labels.description: Header names by field, dot paths included.

else.description: A row: any keys; every key becomes a column.
